title: Up Keep Round 2: Member App, Booking, Alerts And Color Pops
brands: Up Keep / Smart Upkeep: home maintenance membership app (https://webermanapps.github.io/smart-upkeep/)
Base: white or cream, #0A0A0A ink, square black buttons, Khand/Hind; 2-3 small pops (terracotta = act, lagoon = info, jungle = done, saffron = due soon); no neon, no pastel, not all-beige
builds_on: upkeep-1 answers (31 of 50): top tags clear, system, warm, lively, multi-accent

pairs.ask: What Should The Dashboard Open On?

optionA.label: Next Visit Card Leads
optionA.desc: After sign-up the dashboard opens on the next visit: date, tech, a reschedule link. Systems sit below.
